brand.tagline: Understand Your Health. Find the Right Care. Reach It Faster.
demo.notice: Demo data is shown in this prototype. It is not live availability.
offline.banner: You're offline. Some information may be unavailable.
home.heroSubtitle: Find nearby healthcare, medicines, blood resources and emergency support — all in one simple platform.
home.quickSubtitle: Choose one option. Each one works without creating an account.
home.findCareDesc: Find nearby hospitals, clinics and healthcare centres.
home.findMedicineDesc: Search nearby pharmacies and medicine availability.
home.findBloodDesc: Find blood banks and available blood groups.
home.medicalReportDesc: Upload a report and understand it in simple language.
home.emergencyDesc: Get quick access to nearby emergency healthcare resources.
home.nearbyEmpty: Allow location access or pick a village to see nearby centres.
home.reportSubtitle: Medical reports use difficult words. Upload your report and GramaCare explains each value in simple language — using only the reference ranges printed on your own report.
home.emergencySubtitle: One button finds the nearest emergency centres, shows how far they are, and lets you call or get directions.
home.educationTitle: Learn about health in your language
home.educationSubtitle: Short, simple articles on nutrition, maternal and child health, diabetes, blood pressure and first aid.
home.how1Body: No account needed. Choose your language and start searching.
home.how2Body: Hospitals, medicines, blood, doctors or emergency help near your village.
home.how3Body: Read your report in simple words, then reach the right centre with directions.
home.trustBody: Reports are processed for the explanation you asked for and are not stored unless you choose to save them. GramaCare never gives a diagnosis or prescribes medicine.
home.trustPoint1: No diagnosis, no prescriptions — information only
findcare.title: Find Healthcare Near You
findcare.subtitle: Search hospitals, clinics, primary health centres and laboratories close to your village.
findcare.searchPlaceholder: Search hospital, clinic or healthcare service
findcare.empty: No healthcare facilities were found nearby. Try increasing the search radius.
medicines.title: Find Medicines Near You
medicines.subtitle: Search a medicine name and see which nearby pharmacy reports having it.
medicines.empty: No pharmacy reported this medicine nearby. Try the generic name, or call the pharmacy.
blood.title: Find Blood Near You
blood.subtitle: Check blood groups reported by nearby blood banks and raise an emergency request.
blood.empty: No blood bank reported this group nearby. Raise an emergency request.
blood.requestBody: Share the requirement so nearby blood banks and donors can respond. This prototype does not connect to a live blood-bank network.
blood.submitted: Request recorded. Please also call the blood bank directly.
emergency.title: EMERGENCY
emergency.subtitle: Get help near you, fast. This screen stays simple on purpose.
emergency.transportBody: Ask for an ambulance when you call. If no ambulance is free, arrange a car, auto or tractor with a flat surface and keep the person lying down.
emergency.callNote: Confirm the local emergency number for your region before you travel. Numbers differ between states.
emergency.firstAid: While help is on the way
emergency.tip1: Keep the person calm and still.
emergency.tip2: Do not give food or water if the person is drowsy or bleeding heavily.
emergency.tip3: For heavy bleeding, press firmly with a clean cloth and do not lift it.
emergency.locationDenied: Location access was not allowed. You can search by village, town or PIN code instead.
report.title: Understand Your Medical Report
report.subtitle: Upload your report and get a simple explanation of the information it contains.
report.uploadHint: Maximum 8 MB. Clear scans work best.
report.pastePlaceholder: Paste the values from your report here…
report.noReference: Reference range not provided in the report.
report.disclaimer: Important: GramaCare provides educational explanations of medical information. It does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional for interpretation and treatment decisions.
report.readError: We couldn't read this file. Please upload a clear PDF, JPG or PNG.
report.aiError: We couldn't process the report right now. Please try again.
report.emptyResult: We could not find readable test values in this report. You can paste the text manually below.
report.privacyBody: The file is read in your browser to extract text. Only the extracted text is sent for the explanation, and nothing is stored unless you press Save.
assistant.title: GramaCare Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about health words, reports or how to use GramaCare.
assistant.disclaimer: AI responses are for general information and do not replace professional medical advice.
assistant.urgent: Your message mentions symptoms that may need urgent attention. Please contact the nearest emergency centre or doctor now instead of waiting for a reply here.
education.title: Health Education
education.subtitle: Simple, trustworthy health information. Not personal medical advice.
doctors.title: Talk to a Doctor
doctors.subtitle: Find doctors and specialists, and request a consultation. This is a prototype flow.
doctors.submitted: Consultation requested. The doctor's team will confirm by phone.
doctors.empty: No doctors listed for this specialty yet.
login.title: Login to GramaCare
login.subtitle: Login is optional. You can use most of GramaCare as a guest.
login.name: Full name
login.guestNote: Guests can find healthcare, medicines, blood, health education, emergency resources and the report explainer.
login.userNote: Logged-in users can save centres, save report explanations, request consultations and see history.
dashboard.title: Provider Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Update your centre's demo availability. Changes appear immediately in search results.
admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.subtitle: Operational overview of the GramaCare prototype.
footer.disclaimer: GramaCare is an informational and healthcare-access platform. It does not replace professional medical diagnosis or treatment.
